story.thread: Private details inside shared AI work files
story.thread_subtitle: why the answer on screen and the complete record behind it are not the same thing
story.headline: People published records of their AI work. Some contained passwords.
story.the_story: An August 2026 study examined 6,708 records that people had published so others could inspect or replay AI tasks. The researchers found 328 records containing at least one password, key or other private detail. Some details appeared only in a sealed part of the record — not in the visible chat. The study does not show that ordinary private chats became public. It does show that a file shared for transparency can contain more than the answer its publisher meant to share.
story.laidies_read: The finding is not “private chats leaked.” It is “people published detailed records of AI work without realizing what else the records could contain.” Share a newly checked result instead of the entire record. If people genuinely need to inspect or replay the work, make a fresh file containing only the question, checked result and needed evidence.
story.what_this_means: Share the checked result you intend people to read, not the whole work file. If a public work file contains passwords or access keys, remove access and replace them; deleting the file cannot undo copies.
story.cocktail_party: Researchers examined records that people had deliberately published so others could inspect or replay AI tasks. Some contained passwords and other private details, including details absent from the visible chat. This was not evidence that ordinary private chats became public. The practical rule is to share the checked result, not the whole record behind it.
story.watch_fors: A corrected paper, peer review, provider statement, independent reproduction or material change to provider continuity-data handling.
story.closing_note: Before sharing, ask: am I sending the answer I chose, or the whole work file that made it?
story.class_notes: The durable concept is the difference between an approved output and the complete production record that created it. A visible redaction does not inventory unseen fields in the larger record.

sources.label: Panfilov et al. — Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs

story.saint_lane: Elle Woods · Share the checked result, not the backstage file
